caseNameFull: Holman v. Matthews, Commissioner of Banks of Wisconsin
attorneys: Frank P. Barker and Ray M. Stroud for appellant. Vernon W. Thomson, Attorney General of Wisconsin, Stewart G. Honeck, Deputy Attorney General, and Roy G. Tulane, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee. Urban A. Lavery filed a brief for the Interstate Collectors Association, as amicus curiae, in support of appellant.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Wisconsin.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
